description: Per-user S3 usage and performance analytics. Usage metrics show stored bytes/objects per owner. Performance metrics show per-user operation throughput and latency.

panels.description: Total bytes stored in all buckets owned by the selected user (usage metric).
panels.title: Stored Bytes

panels.description: Total number of objects stored in all buckets owned by the selected user (usage metric).
panels.title: Stored Objects

panels.description: Maximum bytes per user/account quota (-1 = unlimited).
panels.title: Quota: Max Bytes

panels.description: Maximum number of objects per user/account quota (-1 = unlimited).
panels.title: Quota: Max Objects

panels.description: Bytes currently stored per bucket for the selected user. Source: usage metric (gauge, not a rate).
panels.title: Stored Bytes per Bucket

panels.description: Number of objects per bucket for the selected user. Source: usage metric.
panels.title: Object Count per Bucket

panels.description: PUT bytes from per-user performance counter (cumulative counter, not stored capacity).

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) ((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_bytes{user=~"$owner"}) *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: PUT Bytes (Performance)

panels.description: GET bytes from per-user performance counter.

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) ((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_bytes{user=~"$owner"}) *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: GET Bytes (Performance)

panels.description: PUT operation count from per-user performance counter.

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) ((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"}) *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: PUT Operations

panels.description: GET operation count from per-user performance counter.

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) ((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"}) *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: GET Operations

panels.description: Per-user operation counts from performance metrics. Filtered by selected user.

targets.expr:
sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"} *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"} *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_list_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"} *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_del_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"} *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

sum by (user, ceph_daemon) (ceph_rgw_op_per_user_copy_obj_ops{user=~"$owner"} *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })
